What's actually wrong (short):
- Postgres is refusing the connection because the client IP 10.2.4.19 has no matching rule in the server's pg_hba.conf — this is an authentication/host-allowlist issue, not a bad password. The env dump shows the password was present in logs (don’t share it).

One-liner to paste to the team:
"Postgres on db-prod-2 is blocking our app: 'no pg_hba.conf entry for host 10.2.4.19' — either add an appropriate host/CIDR entry for that IP (or the app's egress range) in pg_hba.conf and reload Postgres, or route the app through an allowed IP; also note DB creds were printed in logs so rotate them if that log is public."

If you want, I can draft the exact pg_hba.conf line to add and the reload command for the DB host.
